The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, cover your mouth when you sneeze.

People around Nina often share different ideas about the gym. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What's more, I unwind after work by walking along the river.

On Sunday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Jack advised Nina to try drawing as a new hobby. Nina will take part in a basketball match in April. In fact, she keeps slim by walking every day.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The swimming pool has become an important part of daily life.
